_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); personal-computer and consumer-electronics signals

pit_profile.why: Apple: it 'designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services', and is 'the only authorized maker of hardware using OS X, which has a minority market share in the personal computer market' (its own FY2014 10-K); 437 retail stores; its products and services 'compete in highly competitive global markets characterized by aggressive price cutting and resulting downward pressure on gross margins': a margin risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Apple: it 'designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services', and is 'the only authorized maker of hardware using OS X, which has a minority market share in the personal computer market' (its own FY2014 10-K); 437 retail stores; its products and services 'compete in highly competitive global markets characterized by aggressive price cutting and resulting downward pressure on gross margins': a margin risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.30x; +72% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.42; conservative 2yr +22%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.0%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +18.5%/yr (Q4 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +45.4%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +74.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AAPL (retrospective, 2015-10-16) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.30x (49.6% downside to Bear $56 / +166.6% upside to Bull $296) | Adj composite 2.19 vs market 1.77: gap +0.42 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +72% above the EPP floor $64 (10x FY15E $6.45) | Conservative 2-yr case: +22.1% total (+11.0%/yr) | At 17.2x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $147 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Mac units +8.7% in Q3 FY15, forward net sales +16.3-21.1% (Q4 FY15 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
